balls.text: Thirty two runs off that last over. What a finish for Mumbai! What bat speed is Shepherd generating, what power! He finishes on 39 off 10 balls. Fuller on middle and leg, he clears his back leg and flicks it powerfully over long-on.
FOUR MORE! Fuller and on pace on the stumps. Shepherd backs and powers it straight back past the bowler. He's hit that so hard that there is no chance for long-on to get across
THREE IN THREE! Offcutter dug into the pitch outside off, he backs away, generates all the pace and thrashes him over deep cover.
WALLOPED! Length ball on middle stump, he hopped across and sends it soaring miles, miles over deep square leg.
What s hit! Slower length ball outside off, he stands tall and deposits the ball flat and hard over long-on
Shepherd gets going now. Slower back of a length ball off, he flat bats it past the bowler, past the stumps and rockets into the fence between long on and long off
Another hit-me delivery and Mumbai have waltzed past 200. Slower ball that was short and wide, David stays still and pummels it past extra cover

Ah, another high full toss and David will accept those gifts every day of the week. Knee-high on middle stump, David gets across and hammers it over deep midwicket. David thinks the ball was over the waist and takes a review. Was it? Nope, the on-field call stays
Another pinpoint yorker on off stump, dug down to  long-off
Slower bouncer chest-high outside off, he pulls it to deep square leg
Another wide. Slower back of a length ball well outside the tramline outside off
Good riposte! Excellent yorker on off stump, he somehow digs it out to the offside
Hit-me ball! In the slot outside off, Shepherd stays back and drives on the up to the right of mid-off.
Slower bouncer outside off, but was way too short. Called a wide on height.
Fuller on off stump, he pushes to long off
Banged in short outside off, Shepherd has a swing at it but can't connect. The umpire calls it a wide. Pant doesn't think it is and reviews. The ball is past the tramline, so the wide call stays

Knee-high full toss and Hardik can only help it to deep backward square leg. He goes for 39 off 33. Was there to be hit. The ball was leg stump, but Hardik just didn't get enough bat on that. Another catch for Jake Fraser-McGurk
Banged in short outside off, was the slower ball again. He can only mistime towards short third
Slower back of a length ball outside off, Hardik looks to cut it away hard, but is deceived by the pace. Can only inside-edge to the keeper
Slower back of a length ball wide outside off. Past the tramline as Pant collects on the bounce to his right. Won't please him
Banged in short, David pulls but down to long-on
Fuller and well outside off. Was past the tramline. He has to reload.
Oh, dear! Chest-high full toss on leg stump. David does well to spot it, get inside the line and just swat it miles over short fine leg into the second tier.
Slower  back of a length ball but the line was down leg. David helps it past short fine leg
Hardik connects and Mumbai have the over they were looking for. Slower offcutter but right in the arc for Hardik, who swings freely and over long-off
Back of a length ball outside off, he cuts it hard to deep point
Belted away over the ropes. Top shot! Was a back of a length ball on middle and leg. He swivels and heaves it over deep midwicket
Angled in on off and middle stump, David drives but straight to extra cover
Fuller outside off, he drives on the up to long off

Slower back of a length ball on his hips, he helps it to deep backward square leg. Oh, what's happened there? So, David gets two and as the throw comes in, Pant collects the ball and fires a throw at the non-striker's end. The ball hits the stumps and ricochets to long off. David though was not aware of it and turned his back. Hardik was down halfway and David then had to run back, put in a dive in. A direct hit and he was a goner.
Length ball outside off, he gets across and works it to deep midwicket
Very full and down leg, Pant does really well with a dive to his left and saves a few extra runs
Another shin-high full toss on the pads of David who flicks it to deep backward square leg
Look at the ball skip away on the outfield. Hardik is belting them well today, just not finding the gap. Length ball outside off, he gets it down to long off
Low full toss on the pads of David, he flicks to the right of deep backward square leg
Fuller outside off, he drives back at the bowler, who does well on his followthrough on his right
David goes big and into the ground. Was the slower offcutter outside off. David drags it, right off the bottom of the bat, but he gets enough bat to clear long-on

Another lovely bit of fielding, this time from Stubbs at long-on. Fuller on off, he drives straight back all along the ground. Stubbs hares across to his left from long-on and releases the ball in a jiffy

Belted but Nortje does well running across from deep cover. Was fuller outside off, a slower ball as well. Hardik hacks away the cover drive. Nortje's knee gets stuck in the outfield, but he makes the stop. Hope is he is fine.
Slower offcutter outside off, he looks to dab it in the gap between backward point and short third, but can't beat the fielder
Banged in short around hip-high, David stands tall and pulls to deep midwicket
Slower good length ball outside off, he mistimes his cut to point and scampers through
135.6kph length ball outside off, he swats his away to deep point
Attempted yorker turns into a low full toss on his pads that David flicks to deep backward square leg to retain strike
Pace on at 132.6kph on off stump, he defends back to the bowler with a straight face of the bat
Slower length ball outside off, he pushes towards extra cover
Slower ball well outside off stump, was fuller as well as he reaches for it and drives to deep cover
Drives on the up and gets four to his name. That is a top shot from the MI captain. Fuller in length outside off, he slams it past mid-off
Good timing and he gets two more. Was a length ball outside off, he opens the face of his bat and punches past backward point. Deep third has to hare to his right
Slower offcutter outside off, he opens the face of the bat and guides to deep third
Goes fuller well outside off, he drives to sweeper cover to get off the mark

Straight to backward point and Mumbai are losing their way! Was a short and wide ball, there to be hit. He looks to go up and over point, but does not get on top of the bounce. Cuts it straight to Axar who is having a good day on the field. The ball was travelling.
Pacy length ball angling sharply back into Tilak who can only defend back to the bowler
Slower length ball just outside off, he mistimes his thrash towards point
Yorker on leg stump, he can only flick it to midwicket
Pinpoint yorker on middle stump, he digs it out to midwicket for a quick single
Fuller on leg stump, he eases it to long on
What timing on that ! Good length ball on middle stump, Tilak backs away and just uses the pace of the ball and thrashes the ball past backward point
Slower offcutter well outside off. He reaches for it and slices to the left of deep point
Goes fuller at 136.7kph on off, he laces the drive but straight to extra cover
Good length ball outside off, he frees his arms and thrashes the cut but can't beat backward point
Length ball outside off, he pushes to deep cover
Saved by the inside-edge. Darted quicker on middle stump, he defends, gets an inside-edge back onto the pat
Pushed quicker on off stump, he pushes towards cover. No run there.
Fuller on middle and leg, clips it to deep midwicket

That is an absolute stunner! Oh, my word AXAR! Flatter length ball on off stump, Kishan hops back and absolutely belts it to Axar's left. He flings out his left hand and takes a stunner. Surely, a contender for the catch of the tournament
SMOKED! Flatter 93.8kph length ball on leg stump. Kishan brings out the slog sweep and smacks him miles over deep square leg.

Oh, dear a yes and no situation but Axar has fumbled. Slower offcutter outside off, he pushes firmly to the right of his partner and sets off. They stutter and eventually go through but a clean pick up and hit from Axar would have seen Kishan walk back
Picked away for six. Back of a length ball on his hips, he shuffles across and helps him deep over square leg
Slower offcutter at 123.5kph outside off. Hardik shimmies down the track and lofts it to sweeper cover. Got that off the outside half of the bat
SMASHED! Attempted bouncer that does not rise up as much, just about chest-high. Hardik gets into position and hammers the pull past midwicket
Pacy 140.5kph length ball just outside off, he opens the face of the bat towards backward point
Fuller in length straying down leg. He winds up but can only send it down to deep fine leg
Flatter outside off, he drives to cover
Good length ball outside off, Kishan stays back and eases it down to long on
Keeps it slightly slower outside off, Pandya gets a thick edge to it towards short third
PUMMELLED! Fuller outside off, he takes a step forward and absolutely thrashes the cover drive. No stopping that
Oh, close. Low full toss on leg stump, he almost chips it back to the bowler. Goes to his right for a run
Flatter outside off, he pushes to deep cover
Another excellent effort this time from Axar at midwicket. Nortje goes length on middle and leg, he drives crisply to midwicket's left, who gets a hand to it and saves three runs
Fuller in length outside off, he drives to the right of deep cover for a couple of runs

Direct hit and Hardik was a goner first ball. Excellent fielding by Lalit Yadav at backward point. Was a fuller ball outside off, he slices it to the right of backward point who dives to his right. Hardik has to scamper back

A two-ball duck for Suryakumar Yadav on return. On a length on middle and leg, he looks to clear mid-on but does not get the right of timing on it. Jake Fraser-McGurk, out as a substitute, runs back and takes a good catch, reverse-cupped.
Oh, what a ball to receive first up! Huge appeal for lbw, not given says the umpire. A yorker on leg stump that thuds into SKY's boot. But the ball was likely going down leg.
Length ball to start off at 142.3kph on middle and leg, he works it to deep backward square leg

Through his defenses and didn't DC need that! Was bowled much quicker at 102.9kph and the ball skids through after pitching. Rohit is camped on the backfoot and pokes at it. Gets beaten and the ball clatters into the off pole
Backs away to flatter ball outside off, but can only mistime his slap towards cover
Quicker on off stump, he gets another leading edge to the off side
A hint of turn for Axar. Was bowled at 98.7kph on off stump, he closes he face of the bat early and gets a leading edge to the off side
Shorter in length well outside off, he thrashes the cut to deep point off the backfoot
Kishan gets into the act now. Flatter down leg, he sweeps it to the right of short fine leg. Deep point can't get across in time
Third four of the over and Mumbai have amassed 75 runs in the powerplay. Jumps down the track and lofts Lalit straight over his head. Sixth-highest powerplay score in all IPL cricket
Low full toss again, but Rohit does not cash in this time. Hits it straight to extra cover
Flatter on off stump, he shuffles across and works it past mid-on. Deep midwicket gets across
Lovely shot! Backs away to the low full toss on off stump and just times it all along the carpet past mid-off
HACKED AWAY! Lalit keeps it flatter at 94.7 kph but gives Rohit the room. He stays still, frees his arms and slams him over long on
Fuller and quicker outside off, he drives to long-off
14 off the over and Mumbai are off to a flyer. Quicker on off stump, he gets across and works it to deep midwicket
Goes flat at 94kph on off and middle, he ticks it to deep midwicket
Another sweep and this time Rohit gets a four to his name. Similar to the first ball. Was flatter just on off stump, he sweeps it over square leg. Deep midwicket hares across but can't get to it.
94.7kph length ball on off stump, he works it to deep midwicket
Darted outside off, he stays back and whisks it to wide long-on
And Rohit goes after him right away. Flatter on the middle and leg stump. He gets across, down on one knee and sweeps him hard over short fine leg
Huge, hue appeal from Jhye, the umpire stays unmoved. On a length angling just a touch into Ishan who gets beaten and is rapped on the pad. Was it doing too much? Did the ball pitch outside leg?
Fuller in length outside off, he jumps down the track and times it neatly but can't beat mid-off
Length just outside off, he gets an inside-edge to the keeper
Two in Two! Richardson goes fuller, but that does not change the result. Outside off, he gets across and just helps him over deep square leg. Not the best of timing, but Rohit won't mind
Rohit Sharma at his absolute best! Back of a length ball around the fifth stump. Rohit spots it early and hammers the pull over deep square leg.
Ouch! Pacy back of a length ball shaping back into the batter, who is hit in the midriff.
BANG! Low full toss on off stump. He punches it hard and over the bowler's head for a four. 12 off that Khaleel over. Mumbai have started well
Over mid-off. Fuller in length outside off, he looks to go up and over. Warner gives chase and keeps them down to two. Kishan got it off the bottom half of the bat.
SHOT! Back of a length ball just outside off, he frees his hands and the fast hands of Kishan means he gets the pull away in a flash over mid-on
On a length on and around off stump, he goes back and across and punches to backward point
Good length ball just outside off, he slaps it towards cover-point
Fuller in length on the pads of Ishan, he clips it over midwicket not entirely off the middle of the bat for a couple of runs
Good length ball outside off, shaping well away from Rohit. He throws his hands at it, and misses once more. Will be miffed at not getting that away
Length just outside off, he presents a full face of the bat and pushes towards cover
Jaffa! On a length with a hint of shape away from Rohit outside off. He pokes at it and misses
Play and a miss now! Length ball with a hint of nibble outside off. Rohit feels for the ball and is lucky to not edge it
Oh, dear the attempted slower ball goes horribly wrong for Ishant. Looks like the ball stuck in his hand and he ends up spraying it well down leg. Pant can't get across
UP AND OVER! Length ball just outside off, angling into Rohit. He lofts him neatly over mid-off. A clean swing of the bat and he gets four more.
Well, well innovation nice and early from Rohit. Length ball outside off, a bit of pre-meditation as he gets down on one knee and scoops him over short fine leg
Some swing first up for Ishant but sprays the length ball down leg. Called a wide
Good end to the over. Fuller in length outside off, he looks to force it through the off side, squirts it off the inside half of the bat to mid-on
Short, wide, and cut away for four. Was a back of a length but there was a lot of width for Kishan to free his arms and thrash it away past backward point
A bit more confidence from Rohit. On a length angling away from Rohit, who drives on the up to deep point
Fuller in length swinging away from Kishan well outside off. He looks to loft it over covers, gets it off the outer half of the bat to deep point
Length ball angling away from Rohit who gets an outside edge down to deep point's right for a couple of runs
On a length on off stump with a hint of nibble in, Rohit defends

the short ball has done the trick for Coetzee yet again this over. Short, angling away, beats Richardson for pace as he looks to pull in front of square, slices it straight to Rohit at point.  Mumbai Indians are off the mark in IPL 2024.
yorker-length on middle and leg, squeezed past midwicket for a couple
sliced over the infield to point, as easy as catches come for Tilak. Kushagra was looking to go down the ground but the ball got away from his arc.

excellent catch from Ishan Kishan! Swirler as Lalit Yadav looks to fetch this slog from outside off only to get the top edge, Kishan called for it, ran towards where backward square leg would be and picked it nicely.
goes wide Yorker from around the stumps, dug out, good stop off his own bowling.
toe-ends a slog to the man coming in from deep midwicket

gets inside the line and helps this pull to clear fine leg. Big over but Stubbs won't be on a strike as Capitals need 34 off the final over. Romario went into the pitch with a slower ball, Stubbs anticipated that and quickly moved off side to pick his spot. Superb batting this. What a knock this has been.
cut way to deep point for a single.

heaved sown to wide long-on, they'll take two. Wonder if Stubbs needed to take a single off the third ball. But anyway, what's happened here is Axar has been run out at the striker's end because of some lazy running. He was ambling for the second, under the assumption no one was in a hurry. Kishan didn't give any hint of the throw coming his way. But then suddenly gathered the throw and broke the bails to catch him a few yards short. Tardy from Axar.
bowls a cutter into the deck, slapped to sweeper cover
he's walloped that over wide long-on for another six! Goes for a Yorker, misses his length but Stubbs has backed away to swing through cleanly and picks the bones out of that one.
starts with a six! Clears his front leg and swings this down the ground. Straight hit, flat hit. He generated tremendous power behind that stroke. Waited, held his shape and swung hard.
whips this full toss down to long-on
into the blockhole, on leg stump, dug out to point
slices this full toss past the diving cover fielder but it's not going to really bother MI.
punches this full toss to long-off
backs away, Bumrah follows him with another toe-crusher, squeezed to point for a single
right into the blockhole,  Axar somehow manages to save his toes.  Forget about a run
swung away down to deep midwicket, they'll hare back for a second. That's a  19-ball half-century for Stubbs
squeezes this yorker-length delivery to square leg.
driven straight to cover, no chance of a single
into the blockhole, squeezed to point
smokes that low full toss through extra cover! Rifled it off the bottom hand.
flicks this full toss over deep midwicket! Terrific pick-up shot for six. That should put pressure on Madhwal. What's worse is he has overstepped too. Free-hit coming up for Stubbs.
reverse-scooped over short third! Took it on the full and deflected it nicely. One bounce to the boundary.
strange little innings from Pant is over. Was looking to helicopter this over midwicket, ends up getting a leading edge to cover. Didn't look in any control today.
into the blockhole on leg stump, dug out but can't get even a single. Looks like Pant lobbed it back to the bowler, who put it down on his followthrough
swung away down to deep midwicket for a single
slower ball, dips on Stubbs but he takes it on the full and deposits the slog over deep midwicket. Superb timing.
chips this Yorker to the man coming in from deep square. Pant was taken aback by the Yorker on leg-stump. Seems like he was shaping to scoop that over short fine

appeal for lbw as Stubbs appears to play the reverse scoop to a full ball angling in from around the stumps. He was struck on the pad with the point of contact beyond the line of the stumps. Not out it is.
heaves this full toss straight to long-on. No control or timing on that shot, hit it off the bottom. Easy as catches go.
beaten by a Yorker outside off. Looked to squeeze this behind point
scooped for four! Slower and fuller on the stumps, Porel moved across really late, exposed all three stumps but somehow managed to make contact with that scoop to beat short fine leg.
into the blockhole once again, dug out into the leg side and a single is all they'll get
squeezed to long-on
that patented dipping slower ball outside off, Porel beaten as he heaves across the line
pulled to wide long-on, aggressive running sees them pocket two when it should've have been the case.
in the slot and he's hammered that down the ground for four! Long-on, long-off didnt' have a chance.
hit hard to long-off
into the blockhole, squeezed out to long-on
driven to sweeper cover, two more as the boundary rider comes around.
slower length ball outside off, cut hard to point, good half-stop there keeps it to a single. Superb stop from Tilak, diving full stretch to his left one handed.
driven to cover
that has been sent soaring into the stands, the second tier at deep midwicket. Too much flight on middle, Stubbs has swept that ferociously. What muscle.
nudged into the leg side
works it wide of midwicket for a single
heaved into the leg side for six! Tipped over by Tilak who was looking to push the ball back into play at deep midwicket.
drilled to cover where Rohit took a lot of speed off the ball, rolls towards the boundary where it's pulled back
dabs it to short third, off the mark

cleans him up with a toe-crusher! Full, fast, the late tail. It curves in furiously as Prithvi jams his bat down to keep it out, but is beaten by a few milliseconds as the leg-stump is flattened. Bumrah is chuffed. How often does he do that?
mistimes this dipping slower ball to mid-off but they scamper a single
yorker-length, squeezed to cover
picked off his pads, one bounce to deep midwicket
slower and fuller on middle and leg, worked to the man coming in from mid-on for a single

dropped at cover, Coetzee, what have you done? Porel looks to heave this full toss into the leg side, skews it to the off side. Coetzee got to the ball and may have just relaxed a touch expecting the job to be done but suddenly saw the ball bobble out.
sliced for four! Porel sees width, opens the bat face to pick the gap between short third and point.
slogged across the line to long-on, no timing.
scythed behind point, a half-stop keeps it to a single
flayed to deep cover

oh, dear. Nabi has made a mess of it at long-on. Should've fielded that. Madhwal went full, Porel launched it down the ground expecting it to be a single, but Nabi misjudged it and got too close to the ball, ended up letting it through.
just eludes deep square leg! Gets underneath the length and slog-sweeps it over the ropes. Incredible timing.
can't pick the gap! Nabi goes full and straight, Prithvi hits it to cover
shortish on middle, tucked behind square as they jog the single
swept up and over the infield to deep square
works it gently into the leg side for a quick single
drills this full toss to deep cover
in the slot and hammered! Porel cleared his front leg and teed off like a golfer. Capitals beginning to get a move on.
punched to deep point
cut away up and over point! Saw this short and wide, Prithvi had to reach out for it and he did well to hit it well.
pulled all along the ground, beats long leg. Lovely roll of the wrists to keep it down. Timed superbly as well.  hat's his half-century. Started slowly but is beginning to make up for it now
cuts to deep point, they jog another single
slapped to deep cover
leading edge, rolls down to long-off.
drilled! Advances down the pitch to get underneath the length as he hammers it flat and hard. Straight hit too.
cuts hard and splits the gap between point and short third! Played it literally off the stumps. Lovely
nailed! Down on one knee as he swung through the line to clear long-on. Prithvi will need many more of that.
whips it to deep square leg
skids one on a length, hit back to the bowler as he mistimes a pull
heaved towards cow corner, two more into the kitty.
punched past the bowler for a single
works it into th gap between deep midwicket and long-on, good work by Tilak Varma
punched down to long-on
whips this off a length to deep midwicket
works it to long-on

punched on the up past the diving cover fielder, a teaser for Tim David and he puts in a dive to pull it back in. Chawla with the mopping up. They'll have a look to see if he was in contact with the skirting when he pulled the ball back in. Seems a tight call.
deft touch for four! Hanging back inside expecting the short one, ends up dabbing it gently wide of the keeper as the ball arrives.
beaten as he tries to flay that through the covers
heaves it to deep midwicket for a single, no timing or power.
dug in short, Prithvi looks to dangle the periscope as he ducks under the bouncer, beaten. Capitals have challenged the decision,  Prithvi thinks this is wide and he's right.  Wide called.
makes room but the bowler does well to take pace off as he bowls on a length, pushed to mid-off
clobbered over mid-on! Heart would've been in his mouth. For a second, Prithvi thought he'd holed out. Hit it too well.
looks to whip it over square leg but is hit on the pad. Ball may have pitched outside leg.
driven crisply but straight to mid-off
there's protection at deep midwicket this time as Prithvil pulls, they jog the single

beaten for pace but still gets four! Cramped for room as he plays the short-arm jab, somehow manages to get it up and over the infield, trickles to the midwicket boundary. Not convincing but he'll take the runs anyway they come now.
ramped over the keeper's head, nicely done. Needs more of that. Both feet were off the ground when he made contact
looks to sway out of the way but makes a belated decision to pull this skiddy bouncer, mistimed to midwicket
works this slower one to mid-on for a single
whips this to deep square

bottom hand comes off the bat handle as he reaches out to slog across the line, but the slower ball gets him! Warner holes out to mid-on as he gets absolutely no power or timing behind that stroke. Simplest of catches for Hardik.
that's a hit! Warner has whacked that into the second tier. Sat up nicely and Warner played the pick up over square leg superbly, as if he was expecting it.
heaves this to deep square, no timing whatsoever
dabs this gently to short third again
mistimes a pull to midwicket
not middled but it trickles to the midwicket fence as Warner lifts this length ball over the infield
hit on the pad as Warner tries to swivel back and help this length ball over the infield on the leg side. Lost his balance and fell on the floor.
squeezes this full delivery to mid-off. Warner was deep inside to get to the pitch.
beaten as he tries to slap this away-going length ball
nearly chopped on!  Hint of width, looks to absolutely thrash that through the covers. No timing. So lucky
bunts this off-cutter to short third again, quiet start for the Capitals.
backs away, Bumrah follows him with a short ball into the body, Prithvi bails out somehow
help yourself buffet ball down leg  and Prithvi tickles it down leg past the keeper. Easily done
yorker-length, swinging in from outside off, squeezed out. Prithvi was looking to scythe this behind point but couldn't get enough bat on it.
looks to force this through the covers, no timing behind the stroke
short of a length outside off, Prithvi dabs it to short third.
into the blockhole, squeezed to mid-on as they scamper a run. Prithvi was running diagonally and may  would have  been in trouble with a direct hit.  Good over for Mumbai.
floated full on middle, worked to mid-on.
tucked off his hip to midwicket. Hit hard length that time
floated full on off, punched to point
width outside off, Prithvi throws the kitchen sink at that and slashes it for six to the third man boundary. There was no fielder there.
roughs him up with a short ball that rears up on Prithvi as he awkwardly defends on the hop
